---
title: "About"
subtitle: "Marketing data science, consumer behaviour, and practical measurement."
---

I'm Yannick, a marketing data scientist with a background in psychology. This is where I
write about measurement, consumer behaviour, and the practical questions that come up
when working with data. I also write about my homelab and other things that catch my
interest.

My approach is to start with the question, make assumptions visible, and use the
simplest method that can answer it credibly. The [blog](blog.qmd) collects working notes
and longer articles; [projects](projects.qmd) show the analysis behind them.
